# Regex size limit and legacy rule handling

User-defined patterns compiled by the lint rules crate are limited to 8MB (8 * (1 << 20)) using RegexBuilder; exceeding this limit triggers Error::CompiledTooBig and reports the rule ID without aborting. Since the standard regex crate lacks lookaround and backreference support, rules requiring these features are stored in rules/legacy/ and utilize the fancy-regex crate.
